name: svn-next-desktop
description: svn-next Electron 客户端（M4 第一步：单人提交闭环）

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/stage-assets.cjs && node scripts/check-startup-assets.cjs
scripts.start: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron .
scripts.smoke: npm run build:native && npm run build && node scripts/smoke-single-user.cjs
scripts.pack: npm run stage && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run stage && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.pack:unpacked: npm run stage && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config.asar=false
scripts.dist:unpacked: npm run stage && npm run build && electron-builder --config.asar=false
